{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Define sentinel value
sentinel_value = 999999.99

# Filter out sentinel values
sales_df_clean = sales_df[sales_df['revenue_clean'] != sentinel_value]

# Now, filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = sales_df_clean[
    (sales_df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (sales_df_clean['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Output the result
mean_revenue"}
